content: Topankite Kakakawel Baliya

Valila palopitau hi gan, yaa palopitau kakakawel hi gan al gamagalau Isileli gamwaliyaa. He i ola al topankite kakakawel abwe nihi masal gamwamiwa. Heliya panpankiti kakakawena nihi pwatanim ge nihi panpankiti-an, inoke wami abulilek nihi apapanak-an. Babala toto i pwamola pasikalil nihi towani, inoke lahena Yehoba abwe ni apapanak-agil.
Toekelesiya nihi gewi topankite ya wali ganawal paganina nihi toulil, yaka wali ginol paganina o gamagalau tola nihi kite ge kamwasa tutunahotina nihi awa nanakan.

Topankite kakakawel heliya hi nuwa gogomwau, inoke liwan enuna nihi goliwaliwan-an ya yaka eliyana mani bwabwatana nihi ahe eliyamiu. Ali lahi iyaka beyaunana Yehoba i baunan ge elana abwe ni apapanak-agiliya.

Tunahot Yehoba abwe ni lahel, kaiwena aneloseyau bolo sauga houhouwena hi gegi Yehoba nige i aatilomwan-agil, yaa i yoho lowagiliek gol toto milaulauina hot elana, inoke i yowanil ge i teleliek gogou gamwanaa nihi matamatan yatala mowamowasena kaiwena.

I ola al gamagalau houhouwel Nowa wana sauga elana, heliya togolu gegetoga, Yehoba nige i nunuwanak-agil, yaa nub bwabwatana elana i pwamowasel. Bolo i pwamwalil iyai ya te Nowa, iya topapaatena sasapona, alonau ge gamagalau enuna al ali gewi seben.
I ola al panuwa Sodoma ge Gomola Yehoba i lahel ge i ton olagil, inoke abapankite i ginol bwaliga ga ni ginol ola togolu gegetoga elal.
Yaa Lote iya maisena wana pagan i waisi inoke Yehoba i pwamwal. Lote amnana i nak nabi gamagalau nanakil o wali ganawal paganina kaiwena.
Iya lan gegewena i miminaa gamwaliyaa, yaka wali ginol nanakina i gagayawa-an ge wali baaba nanakina i haguhagu, inoke atena i lomwan nabi.

He i ola to, inoke ta atena, sauga ebo tosasapol labose nihi pwawa, Yehoba bosowaina hot ni pwamwalil, ge bosowaina tonanakil ni kukuhikagil nihi matamatan yatala mowamowasena kaiwena yaka abwe ni lahel.

Tonanakil gegewel baliya te, yaa bolo hi talamwagil tuwan ana hebabala nanakina elana ge logugui gegewena hi awatautau-an, heliya te ali lahi ni bwata hot. Topankite kakakawel bolo ya hi hanaha hot, tomilabulabum nige hi aawatauwagil, yaa hi ba panapanak-agil.
Yaa aneloseyau, bwagana topankite ya hi gasisi lakel, nige hi babaa panapanak-agil Yehoba matanaa.

Heliya hi ola bwasumu nige wali nuwatu sasapona i gagan, inoke bugul bolo ali sapu nige hi aatena hi ba panapanak-agil ya. Gamagalau bwasumu hi libil ge hi apanakil, inoke i ola to Yehoba abwe ni apanakil,

nak bolo hi ginolil ana lahi nihi pwawa. Heliya ali eyaliyaliyaya te lan gamwanaa nihi mimi anan ge nihi mimi imwim. Sauga alomiyau ku anan toyawa, heliya wami abapuluwawi hi awaginol, kaiwena nuwaliya ya te nihi mimi anan ge nihi mimi imwim.

Nuwaliya hot te avaliyau ge yowau nihi gagaganawal. Sauga gegewena gegi ana awaawaginol ana kamwasa hi loyaan. Bolo nige wali abulilek i gagasisi nuwaliya hi gove inoke hi ahel. Heliya tonuwa gogomwau hot. He Yehoba iyaka i ba haba abwe ni lahel.
Heliya kamwasa sasapona hi eguluwai, inoke hi nogegegi ge Belami, Beo natuna, wana kamwasa hi toulil.
Belami iya i nuwa mani inoke wana ginol nanakina kaiwena nuwana mani ni ahe,
yaa Yehoba i ba lopwali. Bwasumu nige hi baaba, yaa donki etega gamagal analiya i baunan yaka palopita o wana nuwatu sisigana i kaus.

Nasi nige labe waiwaisana etega ta pwapwawa eliyalil. Heliya hi ola wewel etega iyaka i kekepa, ge hi ola yaluyalu mana i yu payopayou-an. He Yehoba abaliya iyaka i lovivina-an haba nihi miminaa gogou kubwa gamwanaa.
Heliya hi babaa hanahanaha, yaa wali baaba nige enona. Hi ba bosowaina ya ganawal paganina ta ginol, inoke eliyana gamagalau bolo abwe hi lou egona gogou paganina elana, nuwaliya hi gove ge hi ahel.

Hi batelel hi ba, “Ama wama kamwasa nuku toulil inoke nige bugul etega ni kakausimiu, nige bugul etega ni lologugui-agimiu.” Yaa age heliya iyaka hi tabwa gegi paganina wana tololoyowan, kaiwena ebo bugul etega gamagal ni logugui-an, he gamagal o iyaka i tabwa bugul o wana tololoyowan.

Wala Babala ge wala Topwamwal Yeisu Keliso ana aatena eliyana valila panayawi paganina nanakina hi eguluwan, yaa abwe panayawi paganina i yowanil al ge i logugui-agil. Inoke yawaliliya ana minamina valila i nak, yaa sauga ya abwe i nak hot.
Binimala bahi kamwasa sasapona nihi aatena, yaa Yehoba wana logugui toto apostolowau hi panpankiti-an hi atena ga, yaka abwe ana en hi pek al, inoke abwe i nak hot elal.
Heliya wali pagan i olaolaek hot te ba gohalibe bolo ya: “Wanuka ni nosikal ni na mamanuvena ni an” ge “Ebo bobu tuwana ta ul yoho, inoke ni sikal ge ni lopweyapweya al.”

footnotes.text: Namba awalehina 22 i pamasal Mowabi wali kin i bateli mani bwabwatana ni pek Belami elana ebo Belami ni nem ge nuwamut ana palopisai ni baunan Isileli elal inoke tuwaliya ni beyabeya.
